t: Din ek lehitnaheg battepillin behikkonso lebet hakkisse
s: Din ek lehitnaheg battepillin behikkonso lebet hakkisse ubo t' seipim: asur likkanes lebet hakkisse qabua lehashtin bitpillin shebberosho o bizroo, gezera shemma yaaseh bahen tzerakayv, abal bebet hakkisse arai dehaynu maqom sheen regilin lippanot sham ligdolim — muttar lehashtin bahen, veen chosheshin shemma yippaneh sham apillu hu maqom tzanua. Veyesh mi sheoser lehashtin bitpillin apillu shello bebet hakkisse — gezera shemma yapiach bahen, ki ken derek hammashtinim, utepillin tzerikin gup naqi. Veyesh lachosh lidbarayv. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshehen alayv, abal keshehen bekisan veochez hakkis beyado — muttar lehashtin bahe[n] ledibre hakkol, shekkeshehen bekisan — en issur bahapacha ledibre hakkol, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman mad. Veim enan bekisan ella ochazan beyado, apillu im topesan bebigdo ubeyado — asur lehashtin bahen meummad apillu shello bebet hakkisse, shemma yeshapshep beyad zo et nitzotzot me raglayim sheyyippelu al raglayv keshemmashtin meummad:
Abal im hen becheqo vechagar chagora, veken im hen tzerurin uqeshurin bebigdo sheen tzarik (ayyen bemah shennitbaer leel) leochozan beyado — muttar lehashtin bahem apillu meummad:

Abal im mashtin meyushshab o baapar tichuach sheen nitzotzot nopelin al raglayv — muttar lehashtin bahen apillu keshehen megullin beyado. Ubilbad shello yikkanes bahen lebet hakkisse qabua — gezera shemma yaaseh bahen tzerakayv keshehen megullin beyado, kevan shehu maqom shergilim lippanot bo ligdolim. Abal im ochazan bebigdo beyado — muttar apillu laasot bahen tzerakayv bebet hakkisse qabua. Vetzarik sheyyochazen bimino keneged libbo, abal lo bismolo, shemma yeqannach bah, abal beyamin en meqannechin. Uleshipshup nitzotzot en lachosh keshennipna ligdolim, sheap shei epshar ligdolim belo qetannim, shemmittok sheddocheq atzmo ligdolim ba lide qetannim, mikkol maqom min hassetam hu oseh tzerakayv meyushshab, umeyushshab en lachosh lenitzotzot. Veyizzaher legolelan baretzuot shellahen, shello tehe retzua yotzea mittachat yado tepach, sheggam baretzuot yesh qedushsha, shehare d' veyu"d shel shadda"y qebuim bahen. Ukeshehu yotze marchiq arba ammot mippetach bet hakkisse umenichan alayv. Veken keshenniknas — tzarik lecholtzan berichuq arba ammot mippetach bet hakkisse, umaknisan bebigdo beyado. Vaapillu hanniknas lebet hakkisse qabua lehashtin mayim — tzarik lecholtzan berichuq arba ammot. Veap al pi sheen issur min haddin lelek bitpillin apillu tok arba ammot shel tzoa atzmah, mikkol maqom kevan shezzeh tzarik hu lachalotz tepillayv mishshum gezerat chakamim shemma yaaseh bahen tzerakayv — yesh lo lecholtzan miyyad shemmaggia learba ammot shel bet hakkisse, shehen kearba ammot shel tzoa atzmah kemo sheyyitbaer besiman pag. Abal yakol leholikan immo beyadayv ad bet hakkisse, vesham yochazen bebigdo beyad yamin im yashtin meyushshab o baapar tichuach. Abal im yashtin meummad — lo yoliken immo lebet hakkisse, ella yitteno lachabero, ella im ken molikan bekisan. Abal hanniknas lebet hakkisse qabua laasot tzerakayv meyushshab — en lo littenan lachabero shekkevan shehittiru lo chakamim lehaknisan lebet hakkisse bebigdo beyado — yesh lehaknisan immo, kede sheyyishmeruhu min hammazziqim, vegam mitzva leshomran beatzmo. Bammeh debarim amurim shehanniknas lebet hakkisse qabua tzarik lecholtzan berichuq arba ammot? Bebet hakkisse shehatztzoa shebbo hi megulla belo chapira, abal im hi bachapira — hare hachapira hi reshut leatzmo ubet hakkisse shellemala reshut leatzmo, veen lo din bet hakkisse kelal kemo sheyyitbaer besiman pag, umuttar likkanes betoko bitpillin shealayv. Umikkol maqom, qodem sheyyashtin — tzarik lecholtzan ledibre hakkol, kemo bishar bet hakkisse qabua (vegam lekassotan, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman shatv). Bammeh debarim amurim? Lehashtin, abal laasot tzerakayv — tzarik lecholtzan berichuq arba ammot mimmaqom sherotzeh laasot tzerakayv, apillu nipna bemaqom sheeno bet hakkisse kelal ella bachatzero o al pene hassadeh:

Vekol zeh keshennipna bayyom, abal im nipna ballayla o samuk lachasheka sheen shehut lahanichan alayv od achar asiyyat tzerakayv — lo yaaseh bahen tzerakayv apillu hen gelulin bebigdo, velo yikkanes bahen lebet hakkisse qabua apillu lehashtin meyushshab vehen gelulin bebigdo, ella choletzan berichuq arba ammot umannichan bekisan im yesh bo tepach. Abal im en bo tepach — batel hu legabbe hattepillin kevan shehu kilyan. Veim mannichan bikli sheeno kilyan apillu en bo tepach — eno batel legabbehen. Veochez hakkis o hakkeli beyado veniknas apillu lebet hakkisse qabua laasot tzerakayv o lehashtin apillu meummad:

Vekol zeh shehittiru chakamim lehaknis tepillin lebet hakkisse qabua apillu keshehen bekisan, hu bebet hakkisse shebbassadeh, shei epshar lehatznian chutz lebet hakkisse shemma yittelu otan obere derakim. Abal bebet hakkisse shebbabbayit — lo yaknisen kelal apillu bekisan kevan sheyyakol lehannichan bemaqom hammishtammer. Veken lo yaaseh bahen tzerakayv bachatzero, apillu shello bebet hakkisse apillu hen bekisan. Abal muttar lehashtin bahen shello bebet hakkisse qabua keshehen bekisan, apillu hu bebeto vachatzero:

Vaapillu bebet hakkisse shebbassadeh, lo hittiru ella bitpillin sheadam lobeshan kol hayyom veholek bahen bassadeh, vei epshar litroach bekol paam lahashiban lebeto, vegam i epshar lehatznian bassadeh mippene obere derakim. Abal shear separim — asur lehaknisan apillu bebet hakkisse shebbassadeh bebigdo beyado lehashtin meyushshab, o laasot tzerakayv apillu shello bebet hakkisse qabua, ki yakol lehannicham bebeto. Abal muttar lehaknisan bekisan lebet hakkisse qabua shebbassadeh laasot tzerakayv, o lehashtin apillu meummad (abal bebet hakkisse shebbabbayit, o laasot bahen tzerakayv bachatzero apillu shello bebet hakkisse qabua — dinam kitpillin sheasur apillu bekisan). Veseper tora — asur lehakniso apillu bekiso lebet hakkisse qabua apillu shebbassadeh kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea siman rapab. Vekol zeh kesherotzeh laasot tzerakayv gedolim, o apillu qetannim ella shehu bet hakkisse qabua veyesh lachosh shemma yippaneh sham ligdolim. Abal im niknas shello laasot tzerakayv kelal — yesh mattirin lehaknisan beyado apillu megullin lebet hakkisse qabua apillu shebbabbayit. Vehu haddin lishar separim. Veyesh mi sheoser beniknas lebet hakkisse qabua shello laasot tzerakayv kemo sheyyitbaer, kemo beniknas laasot tzerakayv. Venakon lachosh lidbarayv. Bammeh debarim amurim? Lehaknisan beyadayv, abal likkanes lebet hakkisse bitpillin shebberosho o bizroo shello laasot tzerakayv kelal apillu qetannim — ledibre hakkol asur bekol inyan apillu hen mekussin al rosho uzeroo, shehare apillu bebet hammerchatz aseru likkanes bitpillin shealayv. Velo ameru sheen issur likkanes lebet hakkisse qabua lehashtin bitpillin shealayv, ella mishshum gezera shemma yippaneh bahen, ella mishshum shellehashtin hu chayyayv shel adam vei epshar bilado, velo hayu matrichin oto lachalotz tepillayv bishbil kak, mah sheen ken keshenniknas shello letzorek. Velikkanes lemerchatz ap shehu tzorko shel adam, mikkol maqom kevan shemmukrach hu lecholtzan bammerchatz kesheyyapshit kol begadayv — hitzrikuhu lecholtzan al petach hammerchatz shello yikkanes bahen kelal lebet hammerchatz. Umittaam zeh hitzrikuhu lecholtzan berichuq arba ammot mibbet hakkisse qabua keshenniknas lehashtin, kemo shennitbaer lemala:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Likkanes lebet hakkisse, abal tzoa sheenah bebet hakkisse — muttar lelek etzlah bitpillin sheal rosho uzeroo, im derek hilluko hu sham, veen tzarik leharchiq mimmenna. Velaken muttar lelek bitpillin sheal rosho bimboot hamtunnapot ap al pi shehatztzoa nireh laayin, veen tzarik lekassot hattepillin shel rosh min haddin. Veap-al-pi-ken tob lekassot bekoba:
Veken muttar larope liqqach abit shel me raglayim libdoq bo hacholeh ap al pi shettepillin berosho. Ubaal nepesh yachamir leatzmo:

Im shakach tepillin berosho veasa bahen tzerakayv — manniach yado alehen lekassotan ad sheyyigmor ammud harishon, sheim yapsiq miyyad yabo lide hideroqan, veyotze vecholetz shel yad veshel rosh vechozer veniknas:
